Data Provider
Content
Format
DEM_AGINGCTR_
DOWNCNT
Down-counting aging counter of contextual
DTC.
1 byte
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
Up-counting aging counter of contextual DTC.
1 byte
DEM_CURRENT_FDC
Fault Detection Counter of contextual
DTC.
1 byte
DEM_CYCLES_SINCE_
FIRST_FAILED
Operation Cycle Counter of contextual
DTC – Operation Cycles Since First
Failed.
1 byte
DEM_CYCLES_SINCE_
LAST_FAILED
Operation Cycle Counter of contextual
DTC – Operation Cycles Since Last
Failed.
1 byte

Operation Cycle Counter of contextual
DTC – Failed Operation Cycles.
1 byte
DEM_MAX_FDC_DURING_
CURRENT_CYCLE
Fault Detection Counter maximum
value during current operation cycle of
contextual DTC.
1 byte
DEM_MAX_FDC_SINCE_
LAST_CLEAR
Fault Detection Counter maximum
value since last clear of contextual DTC.
1 byte
DEM_OCCCTR
Occurrence Counter of contextual DTC.
1 byte
DEM_OVFLIND
Overflow indication of contextual DTCs error
memory:
(0 = FALSE, 1 = TRUE)
1 byte
DEM_SIGNIFICANCE
Event significance of contextual DTC (refer to
DemDTCSignificance)
(0 = OCCURRENCE, 1 = FAULT)
1 byte
DEM_PRIORITY
Priority of the contextual DTC.
1 byte
DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_
IDENTIFICATION
Represents the static value associated to it by
associatedEventIdentification.
4 bytes
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_
SINCE_LAST_FAILED
Tested cycles since last failed excluding test
not complete. The counter latches at 255.
1 byte
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_
SINCE_FIRST_FAILED
Tested cycles since first failed excluding test
not complete. The counter latches at 255.
1 byte
